github_projects.purpose: upstream learning; not a Custos-owned repository

schedules.name: mealplan-monday
schedules.content: Meal-planning week starts. Follow skill custos-mealplan: read `mealplan brief`, propose dinners from the cookbooks within the family's constraints, one message to the Collette Haus group (or one each to Hal and Dani) with the questions from `mealplan prefs`. Track it on one goal for the week (reuse it if it exists).

schedules.name: mealplan-wednesday
schedules.content: New Whole Foods sale week. Follow skill custos-mealplan: `mealplan sales --refresh`, adjust the draft for real sales, no message unless a swap needs a decision.

schedules.name: mealplan-thursday
schedules.content: Reminder day. Follow skill custos-mealplan: send the Collette Haus group (or Hal and Dani) the draft plan and the list summary, ask for last changes before Friday's order.

schedules.name: mealplan-friday
schedules.content: Order day. Follow skill custos-mealplan: finalize the plan, build the list, fill the cart, then message Hal and Dani the plan, groceries, subtotal and how the order is placed this week. Money rules apply: never check out without the host-verified GO.
